name: Four Seasons Hotel Osaka
positioning: Urban luxury hotel in Osaka's Dojima district, in One Dojima, with a modern ryokan floor and skyline-view spa and dining
best_for: Travelers who want an upper-floor city base near Umeda
Guests interested in a modern Japanese ryokan-style floor

facts.text: The hotel has 175 rooms and suites.
The hotel occupies 12 floors of One Dojima.
The hotel is at 2-4-32 Dojima, Kita-ku, Osaka.
The hotel is walking distance from Umeda, a shopping, entertainment and business centre.
The GENSUI Modern Ryokan Floor comprises 21 rooms and suites.
Jiang Nan Chun is a signature Chinese restaurant serving Cantonese cuisine on the 37th floor.
Bar Bota is a cocktail bar on the 37th floor with a circular counter.
Jardin is the all-day dining venue, with 86 indoor seats and 32 terrace seats.
The spa is on the 36th floor and has five treatment rooms.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: Guests on the GENSUI floor have access to SABO Lounge, where they can enjoy a complimentary breakfast.
Tatami Premier Rooms offer floor-to-ceiling views of Osaka.
The spa has a couples' suite with private bath.
The indoor swimming pool is 16 metres long.
Sushi L'Abysse Osaka is the third L'Abysse destination after the two-Michelin-starred L'Abysse Paris.

considerations.text: Parking is available at the hotel for an additional hourly or overnight fee.
The minimum age for spa treatments is 16 years.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
